summary: Migrate messy v1 user records to the v2 schema: names, phones, mixed date formats with DST, duplicate merge, idempotency
hard_because: Many small rules from MIGRATION.md interact on real-world data: name particles, phone prefixes, three timestamp formats including Helsinki local time across DST, merging duplicates by email with a tie rule, and records already in v2 that must pass through.
instruction: We are moving the user store to schema v2. Write migrate.py so that `python3 migrate.py users_v1.json users_v2.json` converts the export exactly as MIGRATION.md describes. users_v1.json is a small real sample. It must also be safe to run again on its own output. Standard library only.
